children: JD Sports Fashion's results confirm a challenging period for the group, analysts at Shore Capital write in a note. The U.K. retailer reported profit before tax and adjusted items of 282 million pounds for the first half ended Aug. 1. This was down from 351 million pounds a year earlier. "While this is far from ideal, it should be broadly expected by the market," David Hughes and Clive Black say, noting that the company published a trading update in August. Shares are down 0.3% to 78.5 pence. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
